name: Illinois

licence_data.on_premise_codes: CSV has license class, business type and a retail type field with values like 'ON-PREMISES CONSUMPTION' vs 'OFF-PREMISES CONSUMPTION'; filter on retail type = ON-PREMISES CONSUMPTION.
licence_data.terms_notes: None seen; file is published publicly on ILCC site as 'Current list of active liquor licenses'. Includes owner/officer details.

local_control: Dual: a local licence from the municipality (or county for unincorporated areas) local liquor commissioner is required first, then the state ILCC licence. The state CSV covers all state licensees.
alternatives: Chicago Data Portal 'Chicago Liquor License lookup' (data.cityofchicago.org, wpui-qyab)
ILCC Daily New and Renewed Licenses page for deltas
ILCC License Lookup / ILCC Portal search
notes: Addresses not confirmed geocoded; plan to geocode via Google Places. Some municipalities are dry by local option. Rows likely contain one row per owner/officer, so dedupe on license number.

sources.title: ILCC current list of active liquor licenses (daily export CSV)
ILCC Daily New and Renewed Licenses

name: Indiana

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Permit types: 210 = liquor/wine/beer retailer restaurant ('3-way'), 210-1 restaurant no carryout, 211-x social/fraternal clubs, plus 2-way (beer/wine) restaurant types; see ATC License Types page.
licence_data.cost: fee ($150 first record + $10 per additional 1,000 records via IN.gov, credit card or IN.gov subscription)
licence_data.terms_notes: Must agree to user conditions before searching; data stated to be public.

local_control: State-issued permits; each county has a local alcoholic beverage board that reviews applications, but ATC holds the list.
alternatives: Free ATC Permit Search (in.gov/ai/appfiles/atc-license-lookup) for single lookups/scrape
ATC Permit Data form on IN.gov AccessGov (in.accessgov.com/indiana/Forms/Page/atc/atc-permit-data/0)
APRA public records request to ATC (in.gov/atc/public-records)
manual_steps: Buy a bulk Excel export at secure.in.gov/ai/appfiles/atc-license-bulk/ (filter to retailer permit types 210/211 etc.), roughly $150-$250 per pull; repeat periodically
Alternatively submit an APRA request via in.gov/atc/public-records for a full active-permit list
notes: About 10,000+ permits statewide. Bulk download is paid, so schedule quarterly rather than daily. Did not confirm whether an IN.gov subscription allows API access.

name: Kansas
agency: Kansas Department of Revenue, Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: On-premise licence types: Drinking Establishment, Drinking Establishment/Caterer, Hotel/Drinking Establishment, Hotel DE/Caterer, Class A Club, Class B Club, Caterer, Public Venue. Filter by license type in the search.
licence_data.terms_notes: None seen. Page has an Excel button (slow due to file size); updated nightly.

local_control: Liquor licences are state-issued, but Cereal Malt Beverage (CMB, beer-only) licences are issued by city or county clerks and are NOT in the state list.
alternatives: City/county clerk CMB licence lists (e.g. Wichita, Kansas City KS)
KDOR liquor licensee search by type/class/county/city
manual_steps: Open kdor.ks.gov/apps/liquorlicensee/Active.aspx and click the Excel export (ASP.NET page; may need headless browser to automate)
notes: Some counties still prohibit liquor-by-the-drink or require food-sales percentage (local option). Beer-only bars/restaurants with only a CMB licence will be missed.

name: Kentucky
agency: Kentucky Department of Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: KY licence types: Quota Retail Drink (QD), Nonquota retail drink types (NQ1 = convention/park/track etc., NQ2 = restaurants/hotels, NQ3 clubs, NQ4 malt beverage by drink), Restaurant Wine; see ABC 'License Types List (June 2025)' PDF.
licence_data.terms_notes: Hosted on Louisville Metro's ArcGIS Hub but described as all active licences issued by the state ABC (statewide).

local_control: State licence plus local (city/county) ABC administrator licence; wet/dry/moist status set by local option.
alternatives: ABC Belle portal licence lookup and reports (abcportal.ky.gov/BELLEExternal)
Louisville Metro ABC Licenses dataset (local licences)
notes: Confirm that the Louisville-hosted 'ABC State Licenses' layer is really statewide before relying on it (description says all active state ABC licences). Many dry/moist counties. Geocoding status of the layer not confirmed.

sources.title: Louisville Metro KY - ABC State Licenses

name: Louisiana
agency: Louisiana Office of Alcohol and Tobacco Control (ATC)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Class A-General (bars) and Class A-Restaurant permits are on-premise; Class B is package/off-premise.
licence_data.terms_notes: Public records requests must name requester and the records sought; ATC responds within 3 days.

local_control: Dual: state ATC permit plus parish/municipal alcohol permit (e.g. New Orleans Alcoholic Beverage Outlet licence).
alternatives: New Orleans 'Alcohol Beverage Outlet (ABO) - Active Licenses' (data.nola.gov, uiry-as9x), updated weekly
New Orleans 'Alcohol Beverage Outlets' (data.nola.gov, qfg2-kjjz)
Parish health inspection data
manual_steps: Submit public records request at atc.louisiana.gov/contact/public-records-requests for a spreadsheet of all active Class A-General and Class A-Restaurant permits; repeat periodically
Or scrape the LAATC license search portal
notes: No statewide bulk file found. Some parishes/wards dry by local option. NOLA data covers Orleans Parish only.

name: Maine
agency: Maine Bureau of Alcoholic Beverages and Lottery Operations (BABLO)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Licence class/type column distinguishes on-premise (e.g. Class A restaurant, Class A lounge/tavern, Class I, etc.) from off-premise; exact field names not confirmed.
licence_data.terms_notes: Published to make commonly requested public data available; includes principal/owner info. Available as .xlsx or .csv, updated early each month.

local_control: On-premise applications must first be approved by the municipality (or county commissioners for unorganized territory); state issues the licence.
alternatives: BELLS liquor license search
Active Liquor Licenses page
manual_steps: Download the monthly .csv/.xlsx from the BABLO License Data page (direct file URL not captured; may change monthly, so scrape the page link)
notes: Control state for spirits (state-run wholesale). Direct file URL not seen in search results.

name: Maryland
agency: Maryland Alcohol, Tobacco, and Cannabis Commission (ATCC) for state/manufacturer licences; 25 local liquor boards for retail

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Retail classes vary by county (e.g. Class B beer/wine/liquor = restaurant/on-sale, Class D tavern); defined per local jurisdiction.
licence_data.terms_notes: ATCC License & Permit Database covers state-issued licences only, not retail.

local_control: Retail licences are issued by 24 county boards of license commissioners plus Baltimore City (25 jurisdictions). No statewide retail list.
alternatives: Baltimore City 'Liquor Licenses' (Open Baltimore, data.baltimorecity.gov xv8d-bwgi)
Montgomery County ABS Licensee Data (data.montgomerycountymd.gov c6rw-fazn, monthly)
Baltimore County annual license book PDF
MPIA public records requests to each remaining county liquor board (Prince George's, Anne Arundel, Howard, etc.)
manual_steps: Pull Baltimore City and Montgomery County open datasets via Socrata API
For other counties, download PDFs/lists from board websites or file Maryland Public Information Act requests with each local board
notes: Montgomery County (and some others, e.g. Worcester historically) runs county-controlled wholesale/dispensaries, hence hybrid. Some areas remain dry by local law.

name: Massachusetts

licence_data.on_premise_codes: M.G.L. c.138 Section 12 = on-premises (restaurant, club, hotel, tavern, general on-premises); Section 15 = package store. In ePLACE choose License Type 'On-premises Retail'.
licence_data.terms_notes: ABCC Active Licenses page lists 'ABCC Active Retail Licenses' but file format not confirmed; ePLACE (elicensing21.mass.gov/CitizenAccess) can generate a list by category.

local_control: Retail licences are granted by the city/town local licensing authority and approved by ABCC.
alternatives: Boston 'Section 12 Licenses (Alcohol)' on Analyze Boston (data.boston.gov/dataset/liquor-licenses)
ABCC public records request (mass.gov/service-details/submit-a-public-records-request-to-the-alcoholic-beverages-control-commission)
Municipal licensing board lists
manual_steps: Open the ABCC Active Licenses page and download the Active Retail Licenses list if a file is offered, or run an ePLACE search for License Type = On-premises Retail and export
Otherwise file a public records request with ABCC for all active Section 12 licences
notes: Format of the Active Retail Licenses list not confirmed from search. A few towns are dry.

name: Michigan

licence_data.on_premise_codes: On-premises retail: Class C, Tavern, Class A/B Hotel, Club, Brewpub, On-Premises Resort, etc.; off-premises SDM/SDD. Filter on licence type column.
licence_data.terms_notes: 'Listing of Active, Conditional, and Escrowed Licenses' Excel sorted by county, local unit and Business ID; filter out escrowed rows.

local_control: State-issued, but local governing body approval is required for on-premises licences.
alternatives: MLCC Active/Escrow License Search (customers.mlcc.michigan.gov/SoM_ActiveEscrowLicenseList)
Detroit 'Liquor Licenses (Current)' (data.detroitmi.gov)
notes: Control state (state is the spirits wholesaler). Direct xlsx link not captured; scrape the Licensing Lists page for the current file link. Exclude escrowed/conditional statuses.

sources.title: Brief Description of All MLCC Licenses & Permits

name: Minnesota
agency: Minnesota Department of Public Safety, Alcohol and Gambling Enforcement Division (AGE)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: On Sale (intoxicating), On Sale 3.2% malt liquor, On Sale Wine, Club On Sale, Sunday, 2 A.M. licences; off-sale = liquor stores.
licence_data.terms_notes: AGE is the statewide repository for city/county-issued retail licences; searchable by city (partial matches allowed). No bulk export seen.

local_control: Retail on-sale and off-sale licences are issued by cities (or counties in unincorporated areas); AGE certifies/records them.
alternatives: Minneapolis 'On Sale Liquor' (opendata.minneapolismn.gov, ~667 records, ArcGIS)
AGE Daily approvals page
Data practices request to AGE for a full retail licence extract
manual_steps: Either scrape the AGE license search city by city, or submit a Minnesota Government Data Practices Act request to AGE (651-201-7000) for a statewide on-sale licence export
notes: Many cities run municipal liquor stores (off-sale) but on-sale is private. 3.2 beer-only licences are local.

name: Mississippi
agency: Mississippi Department of Revenue, Alcoholic Beverage Control (ABC)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: Permit Type column: On-Premises Retailer (restaurants/bars/hotels), Club, Package Retailer (off), Beer/light wine permits (on- or off-premises).
licence_data.terms_notes: Paginated HTML list sortable by business, address, city, county, permit type, permit number; updated Sundays; 'informational purposes only'.

local_control: Local option: counties/municipalities vote wet/dry; state DOR issues the permits.
alternatives: Public records request to MS DOR ABC permit department (601-923-7690) for an Excel list
County/municipal privilege licence lists
manual_steps: Scrape the paginated dor.ms.gov/abc-permits listing (drupal ?page=N) weekly, or request an Excel export from DOR
notes: ~2,700 ABC permits. Control state (state warehouse for spirits/wine). Many dry counties/towns.

name: Missouri
agency: Missouri Division of Alcohol and Tobacco Control (ATC)

licence_data.on_premise_codes: PRIMARY TYPE / SECONDARY TYPE columns, e.g. 'Retail by Drink' for on-premise; package licences are off-premise.

local_control: State licence plus city/county liquor licence required.
alternatives: ATC Reports page datasets (new licences, out-of-business, temporary)
St. Louis / Kansas City city licence lists
notes: Columns: LICENSEE, DBA NAME, ADDRESS, PHONE NUMBER, PRIMARY/SECONDARY LICENSE, PRIMARY/SECONDARY TYPE, COUNTY; no lat/long seen.
